tags: why do dogs lean on you
script: When your dog leans their full body weight against your leg, that's one of the clearest signs of trust and affection a dog can give. In the wild, physical closeness like that would leave an animal vulnerable, so choosing to lean their whole body onto you, essentially giving up their own balance and mobility, signals real comfort and security. Some behaviorists compare it to a calming hug, the contact can lower a dog's stress. It's especially common in dogs who are anxious in a new environment, using you as a stable anchor point. That heavy lean isn't your dog being clingy, it's one of the clearest trust signals they can give. Want more dog behavior tips like this? Check the link in the bio.
